question: What do double broken white lines across the end of your road mean?
options: You have priority over cross traffic
Give way to traffic on the road you are joining
Stop for five seconds even if clear
explain: Highway Code Rule 172 says double broken lines mean give way to traffic on the main road.

question: Before joining a busier road from a give-way line, where should you look?
options: Both right and left for vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians
explain: Highway Code Rule 172 tells you to look both ways for all road users before pulling out.

question: When must you stop completely behind a solid white line with a red octagonal stop sign?
options: Every time, even if the road looks clear
explain: Highway Code Rule 171 and Rule 172 require a full stop at a stop sign and line.

question: If a vehicle on the main road is flashing its headlights at you, what should you assume?
options: It is always safe to pull out
Wait until you are sure the way is clear and safe
explain: Highway Code Rule 172 means you stay responsible for pulling out only when it is genuinely safe.

question: What shape is a red-and-white Give Way sign?
explain: Highway Code Rule 172 uses the inverted red-and-white triangle for Give Way.

question: When turning right out of a side road onto a main road, who must you give way to?
options: Traffic coming from both right and left
explain: Highway Code Rule 172 requires checking and giving way to both directions when turning right.

question: As you approach a Give Way line, what should you do?
options: Slow down early so you can stop if traffic is coming
Keep your speed until the last metre
explain: Highway Code Rule 172 tells drivers to approach under control ready to give way.

question: What if a pedestrian is waiting to cross the side road you are turning into?
options: Give way and let them cross safely
Wave them back and turn fast
explain: Highway Code Rule 170 and Rule 172 require giving way to pedestrians crossing side roads.

question: Why should you check carefully for cyclists and motorcycles at a T-junction?
options: They are narrower and easier to miss against background traffic
They must always stop for cars
explain: Highway Code Rule 172 advises looking carefully for smaller, faster two-wheelers.

question: If parked cars block your view at a Give Way line, what should you do?
options: Edge forward slowly until you can see clearly
explain: Highway Code Rule 172 advises creeping forward safely when parked vehicles block sightlines.

question: When turning left from a side road onto a main road, which direction is the main danger first?
explain: Highway Code Rule 172 checks right first for nearside flow, and left for overtaking traffic.

question: You see a car approaching from the right with its left indicator on. What should you do?
options: Wait until you are sure it is actually turning before pulling out
explain: Highway Code Rule 172 warns never to assume a flashing indicator means the driver will turn.

question: If a main road has two lanes in one direction and you turn left onto it, which lane should you join?
options: The left-hand lane unless road signs say otherwise
explain: Highway Code Rule 172 and lane rules keep turning traffic in the left lane when clear.
